🔬 RAGE ENGINE x64 • SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE & REVERSE ENGINEERING

RAGE Engine Systems Architecture Dissection

A low-level engineering deep-dive into the Rockstar Advanced Game Engine (RAGE) 64-bit virtual memory layout, native function invocation tables, and WebAssembly compilation pipeline.

⚡ 1. Engine Execution & Memory Hooking Pipeline

[1] Process Virtual Memory Space Injection: Hooks process execution inside the 64-bit virtual address space, binding directly into the primary engine threads, the Script Virtual Machine runtime, and the Direct3D graphics pipeline.
[2] Memory Pattern SigScanning (AOB) — Dynamic Address Resolution: Resolves core internal pointers (WorldPtr, EntityPool, ViewProjection matrices) in sub-millisecond execution times using SIMD-accelerated array of byte (AOB) signature pattern scanning across game updates.
[3] Native Invocation & Crossmap Hash Traversal: Traverses dynamic crossmap lookup tables to resolve encrypted 64-bit native function hashes, constructing type-safe argument registers on the scrNativeCallContext stack.
[4] DirectX 11 Present Detour & Overlay Rendering: Injects a low-latency function detour on IDXGISwapChain::Present (VTable index 8) via assembly trampolines, rendering interactive telemetry dashboards at full monitor refresh rates.

⚡ 2. C++ Dynamic Pointer Traversal & Entity Manipulation 

// 1. Dynamic SigScan: Resolve World Pointer dynamically via RIP-relative addressing
uintptr_t dwWorld = Memory::PatternScan("48 8B 05 ? ? ? ? 45 ? ? ? ? 48 8B 48 08");
uintptr_t pWorld  = *reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t*>(dwWorld + *reinterpret_cast<int32_t*>(dwWorld + 3) + 7);

// 2. Local Player Entity (CPed) Instance & Navigation Coordinates
CPed* pLocalPlayer   = *reinterpret_cast<CPed**>(pWorld + 0x08);
CNavigation* pNav    = pLocalPlayer->m_pNavigation; // Offset 0x30
Vector3 playerCoords = pNav->m_vPosition;          // Real-time world coordinates vector

// 3. Vehicle Subsystem & Physical Dynamics Properties
CVehicle* pVehicle = pLocalPlayer->m_pVehicle;    // Offset 0xD10
float engineHealth = pVehicle->m_fEngineHealth;   // Engine state & performance thresholds

⚡ 3. Key Systems Architecture Highlights

Zero FPS Drop Detours ⚡

Sub-microsecond execution latency on render and script threads, preserving maximum monitor refresh rates with zero thread starvation.

Script VM Stack Parser 🧠

Parses compiled .ysc binary script bytecode to monitor global state registers, thread priority queues, and coroutine execution flow.

WebGPU & WebAssembly Compilation 🚀

Architected a WebAssembly and WebGPU execution bridge to stream complex 3D engine assets and shaders directly into client browsers.
